Rina (Docs): Quick sync  drafting a tiny migration note for v1->v2 embeddings. Need a copy-paste Python + curl example that uses the new model_id param, the exact short error text for dim mismatch, and a 1-line changelog blurb for the release banner. Keep everything minimal for localization.

Kevin (SDK): PR open: github.com/redwood/rdw-sdk/pull/5580. We accept model as an alias but prefer model_id. Python snippet you can paste: ```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$RDW_KEY")
map = {"embed-old-512": "embed-new-768"}
mid = map.get("embed-old-512", "embed-old-512")
resp = client.embeddings.create(model_id=mid, input=["hello"])
print(len(resp.data[0]["embedding"]))
```

Kevin (SDK): curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model_id":"embed-new-768","input":["x"]}'`

Lena (Runtime): Exact error example (trimmed): `{"error":"embedding failed: vector_dim 512 != expected 768","code":"ERR_DIM_MISMATCH"}`. For docs use the short text fragment: "embedding failed: vector_dim". Also note: pin model versions if you need identical vectors across rollouts.

Rina (Docs): Good. Troubleshooting line for localization: "If a 400 mentions 'vector_dim', verify model_id and remap or regenerate vectors; pin model versions for deterministic outputs." Under 120 chars? Please confirm.

Priya (L10n): Short and clear, I can localize that single sentence if it's in the PR description. Avoid code punctuation in the sentence.

Sam (PM): Suggested changelog line (1-liner): "Embeddings: param rename to model_id with aliasing; ERR_DIM_MISMATCH on dim mismatch. See migration quickstart." Rina  can we show that as the console banner?

Kevin (SDK): I'll add the changelog blurb and the alias map README to PR 5580.

Lena (Runtime): I'll add a tiny unit test that asserts the 400 contains "vector_dim" and paste the CI link here when green.

Rina (Docs): Action items: Kevin adds changelog + README; Lena adds test; Priya queues localization once PR merges; Rina will open the docs PR with Python + curl examples and the one-line troubleshooting note. Merge when green. :thumbsup:

(End)
